parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan assembly of a ceiling fan, consisting of blades and a central hub made of aluminum.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air, providing cooling and ventilation in a room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or rod of the ceiling fan, typically made of steel for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the fan motor and blades to the ceiling mount, providing stability and housing electrical wiring.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while supporting the rotating fan assembly.
